records.title: 10-Q
records.text: Consolidated net sales for the third quarter of fiscal 2023 were $156 million, an increase of $4 million, or 3% compared to the prior-year comparable period.

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: Core sales, which excludes the impact of foreign currency changes, increased 4%, while foreign currency changes unfavorably impacted sales by 1%.

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: Service core sales decreased 13% compared to the third quarter of fiscal 2022, driven in large part by the implementation of 80/20 analysis and a more selective process for quoting projects in the Middle East region, with a focus on more differentiated solutions.

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: Product core sales increased 9%, which was in part due to the impact of pricing actions.

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: Operating profit was $18 million higher in the third quarter of fiscal 2023 compared to the prior-year third quarter.
